Topics covered in this PDF

MEG-08 (New Literatures in English) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Identity, resistance and cultural negotiation in New Literatures in English, major concerns of Australian writing, Soyinka's A Dance of the Forests, A Grain of Wheat, A House for Mr Biswas
  • Ice-Candy-Man, the poem "Ananse", Omeros, The Solid Mandala, The Stone Angel

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
